rationale: WebContents/BrowserWindow input integration are plausible, but no precise allowlisted IME component exists, so a component label is not mandatory. Although only prose describes a minimal textarea app, blocked/need-info ❌ records an existing supported-version request, which forbids another reproduction request. Retrieved macOS instability, Linux rendering and Unicode truncation reports have different symptoms from an absent IME candidate list. Chrome works on the same machine; speculative Chromium wording is insufficient for an upstream redirect, and this is a bug report rather than a usage question.
